name: Create a rental listing once and syndicate it to every portal
summary: Turns a vacant rental in VaultRE into one listing draft for a person to check, and drafts the reply to each portal enquiry. Crons read and draft; a person approves every reply and sets every listing live.

covered_by.property-details: prepare (facts drafted into the listing note)
covered_by.photos-and-media: prepare (photo and floor plan counts in the note)
covered_by.create-master-listing: VaultRE property record, entered by a person
covered_by.syndicate-to-portals: not covered (VaultRE publishes from its own portal settings; see gaps)
covered_by.check-portal-listings: prepare (lists the portals the account is connected to)
covered_by.enquiry-handling: enquiries (internal note on the contact, reply queued for approval)
covered_by.record-keeping: prepare and enquiries (internal notes on the property and contact)

crons.name: prepare
crons.summary: Read the vacant residential rentals in VaultRE and add one internal listing note per new rental: facts, photo and floor plan counts, connected portals. Nothing goes live.

crons.name: enquiries
crons.summary: Read unprocessed portal enquiries, add an internal note on each contact, and queue the approved reply to the enquirer.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations reach nobody outside the business: reads, plus an internal property note or contact note in VaultRE. Sending an email to an enquirer is a live operation and waits for a person.

vaultre.covers: vacant residential rentals, photos, connected portals, portal enquiries, internal notes, enquiry replies

gaps: Putting a listing live on realestate.com.au or Domain: VaultRE pushes listings from its own portal settings, and no mapped operation sets a listing live on a portal. Approve and syndicate stay manual until a live account confirms the flow.
AgentBox: the public pages read describe none of the listing steps, and its one mapped read (get:/properties) is unconfirmed. No adapter until a live account is checked.
PropertyMe: the docs are partial (vacancies, property sync, inspection photos), but the kit has no PropertyMe platform to build on.
Domain: the kit holds only documentation-tagged reads with unmapped parameters, and no listing write. No adapter until its listing API is mapped and its field names confirmed.
Re-Leased is a commercial platform, so it is not used for residential rental listings.
Writing a reply into the workflow store has no command yet, so the enquiries cron queues only replies already stored there. A reply command is a runtime change for a later session.
An enquiry links to a property only by its lease life id, so the note does not name the property address.
Each run reads the first 100 vacancies and the first 50 unprocessed enquiries. Larger lists need paging.
